szenen.vo: [intense] Look at motivation, bro, it starts so fast, like it's gonna conquer the whole world in one week.
[intense] But motivation runs out, and when it's gone, it crashes harder than anybody saw coming.
[intense] Discipline is slow and boring, one step at a time, every single day, even when nobody claps.
[shouting] And guess who's standing at the top in the end? Not the fastest one, the one who never stopped!
